# FerrumOS

> FerrumOS is a bootable x86_64 Rust research operating system with a deterministic kernel, freestanding Ring-3 AI agent, capability-gated syscalls, and a provider-independent JEPA world-model preview.

FerrumOS targets a documented QEMU/Bochs profile. It is not a Windows replacement, certified safety system, live brain-computer interface, or validated robot controller.

The latest tagged software release is v0.1.1 and has no prebuilt OS image. The capability and benchmark files on main describe the current source tree and later evidence; they do not claim that every current action shipped in v0.1.1.

- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Ferrum-OS/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): protocols, repeated measurements, and limitations
- [Machine-readable benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VyomKulshrestha/Ferrum-OS/main/benchmarks.json): generated benchmark summary
- [Capability catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VyomKulshrestha/Ferrum-OS/main/capabilities.json): 41 source-derived actions and permission tiers

- [Contributing](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Ferrum-OS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): build, QEMU, tests, and pull requests

## Published research

- [Technical report DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21829808): When Agents Control the Kernel: A JEPA World Model Safety Gate with Empirical False-Negative Decomposition
- [Dataset DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21829193): 13,697 accounted transitions from 3,639 QEMU episodes
- [Frozen GitHub release](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Ferrum-OS/releases/tag/world-model-study-v1.0.0): report, dataset, checksums, evaluation, predictions, and training config

## Evidence boundaries

- Published OS safety: authored balanced 500-episode fixture; rules plus JEPA reach 81.4% balanced accuracy and rules plus the per-action mean reach 81.2%.
- Ring-3 preview: 1.29-1.57 ms run-mean range over three WHPX runs; timing excludes provider, action execution, and confirmation.
- Physical JEPA: deterministic simulator evidence only; the artifact is permanently shadow-only.
- Neural decoder: deterministic synthetic SSVEP evidence only; no live EEG, human calibration, medical, or usability claim.
- Cyber-physical software: 152 deterministic contract tests and 32 model/decoder gates pass for the named local regression snapshot. This covers software contracts, not installed simulators/transports, robot hardware, hard-real-time behavior, native hypervisor containment, certification, or independent replication.
- Camera: synthetic YUYV generator in the current release; no UVC hardware driver.
- General claim: automated evidence is not formal safety proof or independent replication.
